candidates.title: Outer Message serializer may emit duplicate role keys before Value normalization
candidates.classification: source-derived serializer behavior; no runtime reproduction or observed production failure

supporting_source.reason: Content manually delegates Serialize to inner structs to avoid duplicate discriminator tags.
Raw discriminator uniqueness is asserted for Content, while message round trips use concrete UserMessage/AssistantMessage/ToolResultMessage; Message enum itself is not instantiated by this suite.

candidates.mechanism: Message derives Serialize with #[serde(tag="role", rename_all="camelCase")]. Every inner concrete variant also serializes its own role field. A raw map serializer that writes the derived tag and all payload fields is therefore expected to receive the same role key twice. Message's custom Deserialize first materializes serde_json::Value, which can normalize duplicate keys before role dispatch.
reachable_conditions: A caller serializes the public ice_ai::Message directly, or a Context.messages collection containing it, through a raw JSON writer instead of first projecting to a deduplicating Value/object.
The serializer honors the derived internally tagged enum and the inner struct's role field as authored.
bounds: No application or test was executed; no raw bytes were captured.

No current production consumer of raw Message/Context JSON was fully traced in this supplement. This is a public-library serialization boundary candidate, not a claimed session-load or network failure.

The inspected active RPC MessageUpdate caller uses serde_json::to_value on AssistantMessageEvent, whose nested messages are concrete AssistantMessage; it establishes the separate RUST-035 spelling path, not this duplicate-role path.
Native AgentMessage kind encoding is separate (AGENT-001) and is not conflated with the base Message role enum.
candidates.suggested_verification: At implementation time, count raw role keys for each Message variant and a Context array, then compare raw and Value round trips. Do not use Value-only equality as proof of raw discriminator uniqueness.
